Questions

Do I need CapCut on a computer?
For the full template, yes: CapCut for computer, free.
Can I use it on my phone?
Yes. The phone kit has the shot guide, shot list and every graphic.
Is music included?
No. Add a sound in Instagram, so your Reel never gets muted. [SOUND PICKS]
Do I need to install fonts?
No, they come with the template.
How do I change the words?
Double-click a text box and type.
My computer warns me about the installer.
That is normal. Click More info, then Run anyway.
Can I swap a clip?
Yes. Right-click it on the timeline and choose Replace.

Listing description

25 Reel templates for CapCut, made for shops that sell physical products: packing videos, before and afters, gift guides, unboxings, reviews, tests, new drops and more. Film a few clips on your phone, drop them in a folder and double-click the installer: the template opens in CapCut with your clips in place. Type your words over the brackets and export. Each template comes with a shot list, a recipe card, a one-page guide and a phone kit. Each one suggests a sound to add in Instagram (no sound files included).

Demo footage to film

Film the demos as two example shops, a soap shop and a T-shirt store, using real products of those kinds, run through the real installer. Never the after.mp4 previews (they show other brands' products). Also film the how-to video for the How it works section. The full shot list for each template is in its zip.
